stories.headline: Broadcom's AI chip revenue triples to $16.7B and it guides to $230B of AI sales by 2028

key_facts.fact: Broadcom reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $29.6 billion, up 86% year-over-year, with AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion, up 221% year-over-year and 54% quarter-over-quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: "Demand for our custom AI accelerators and networking continues to be very strong. Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion grew 221% year-over-year, and 54% quarter-over-quarter," said Hock Tan, President and CEO of Broadcom Inc.

key_facts.fact: Broadcom guided Q4 revenue to about $34.8 billion (up 93% YoY) and Q4 AI semiconductor revenue to $21.7 billion, up 236% year-over-year.
key_facts.excerpt: Q4 2026 Revenue Guidance $34.8 billion Approximate forecast; 93% year-over-year growth ... we expect AI semiconductor revenue to accelerate to $21.7 billion, up 236% year-over-year.

key_facts.fact: On the earnings call, CEO Hock Tan said Broadcom has secured supply to roughly double AI revenue to about $115 billion in fiscal 2027 and has line of sight to $230 billion in fiscal 2028, and said the company is on target to exceed $30 in EPS in fiscal 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: In 2027, we have secured the supply to again double AI revenue to approximately $115 billion. Our demand actually exceeds this outlook... In 2028, we expect the trajectory of growth to continue. We have line of sight for fiscal 2028 AI semiconductor revenue growth to again double to $230 billion.

key_facts.fact: Tan said Broadcom has six XPU (custom accelerator) customers and delivered the Ironwood TPU v7 in high volume to both Anthropic and Google during the quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: Our six XPU customers are accelerating the adoption of custom accelerators and AI semiconductor revenue more than tripled year-over-year to $16.7 billion. During the quarter, we delivered Ironwood TPU v7, version 7 in high volume to both Anthropic and Google.

key_facts.fact: Semiconductor Solutions revenue hit a record $20.8 billion, up 127% year-over-year and 70% of total revenue, while infrastructure software revenue of $8.75 billion came in slightly below the $8.82 billion consensus.
key_facts.excerpt: Broadcom's semiconductor business unit provided the lion's share of its revenue, with sales there tripling from a year earlier to $16.7 billion, surpassing the Street's $15.2 billion target. The infrastructure business added $8.75 billion in sales, just below the $8.82 billion consensus estimate.

key_facts.fact: Free cash flow was $13.7 billion, or 46% of revenue and up 95% year-over-year; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $3.32 versus the $3.24 analysts expected.
key_facts.excerpt: Free cash flow was $13.7 billion, or 46% of revenue... Q3 2026 Non-GAAP Diluted EPS $3.32 Up 96% from $1.69 in Q3 2025

key_facts.fact: Broadcom gave a revenue forecast that disappointed for the current quarter even as results topped estimates, and pointed to expanding business with Anthropic and OpenAI.
key_facts.excerpt: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter, but long-range earnings guidance beat consensus... The chipmaker pointed to expanding business with Anthropic and OpenAI.

stories.headline: HPE posts record $12.2B quarter and a $7.6B AI backlog it can't ship fast enough

key_facts.fact: HPE reported fiscal Q3 revenue of $12.2 billion, up 34% year-over-year, with non-GAAP EPS of $1.11 against the $0.93 analysts expected; revenue beat the $11.91 billion consensus.
key_facts.excerpt: Third-quarter revenue rose 33.7 per cent to $12.21 billion, topping the $11.91 billion analysts expected, while adjusted EPS of $1.11 beat estimates of 93 cents.

key_facts.fact: AI orders set a company record at $3.1 billion — $2.4 billion in AI systems and about $700 million in networking gear sold into AI buildouts — and HPE ended the quarter with a record $7.6 billion AI backlog, $6.8 billion of it in AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Artificial intelligence orders set a company record at $3.1 billion, of which $2.4 billion came from AI systems and about $700 million came from networking equipment sold into AI buildouts. HPE finished the quarter with a record AI backlog of $7.6 billion, $6.8 billion of it in AI systems.

key_facts.fact: Networking revenue rose 74.9% to $2.9 billion and Cloud & AI revenue rose 25.4% to $9.0 billion, with Cloud & AI operating margin more than doubling to 17.0% from 7.0%.
key_facts.excerpt: Networking revenue rose 74.9% to $2.9 billion and Cloud & AI revenue increased 25.4% to $9.0 billion, with Cloud & AI operating margin more than doubling to 17.0%.

key_facts.fact: HPE raised its fiscal 2026 revenue growth outlook to 34%-37% from 29%-33% and its non-GAAP EPS outlook to $3.75-$3.85 from $3.35-$3.45; shares still fell more than 3% after hours on supply concerns.
key_facts.excerpt: HPE raised its fiscal 2026 revenue growth forecast to 34 per cent to 37 per cent, from 29 per cent to 33 per cent previously, and raised its adjusted earnings forecast to between $3.75 and $3.85 per share, from $3.35 and $3.45.

key_facts.fact: Normalized order growth reached 42% year-over-year and management said supply constraints — DDR5 and DDR4 memory, NAND flash and other wafer-limited components — are capping how fast that backlog converts to revenue, and are expected to persist into fiscal 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Orders rose 42% and backlog reached a record level, while AI systems orders climbed more than 30% sequentially. Memory, NAND flash and other component shortages are limiting revenue conversion and are expected to persist into fiscal 2027.

key_facts.fact: HPE also announced an expansion of its work with Oracle, deploying HPE Juniper Networking equipment across Oracle's AI data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: It also announced an expansion of its collaboration with Oracle to help scale the software giant's global AI infrastructure, deploying HPE Juniper Networking equipment across Oracle's AI data centers.

stories.headline: Memory is now AI's binding constraint: TrendForce lifts DRAM forecasts as HPE names it bottleneck #1

key_facts.fact: TrendForce's September 2 spot update said the average spot price of mainstream DDR4 1Gx8 3200MT/s chips rose 2.08% in a week, from $43.64 on Aug. 26 to $44.54 on Sept. 1, even as trading stayed sluggish, because supplier quotes remain firm.
key_facts.excerpt: The average spot price of mainstream chips (i.e., DDR4 1Gx8 3200MT/s) has increased by 2.08% from US$43.64 last week (Aug. 26) to US$44.54 this week (Sept. 01).

key_facts.fact: In the same update, 512Gb TLC NAND wafer spot prices slipped 0.90% week-on-week to $20.708 amid weak consumer demand and cautious procurement.
key_facts.excerpt: NAND Flash spot prices remained largely range-bound amid weak consumer demand and cautious procurement, with 512Gb TLC wafer prices falling 0.90% WoW to US$20.708.

key_facts.fact: TrendForce's September 2 DRAM bulletin said concluded negotiations pushed contract prices higher and prompted an upward revision to the PC DRAM quarterly increase, while HBM negotiations have stalled because next-generation compute platform specifications are still unfinalized — leaving contract prices with 'substantial room to grow'.
key_facts.excerpt: Concluded negotiations pushed contract prices higher, prompting an upward revision to the PC DRAM quarterly increase... Negotiations have stalled as next-generation compute platform specifications remain unfinalized. Contract prices still have substantial room to grow, with further upward revisions possible.

key_facts.fact: On HPE's September 2 earnings call, CFO Marie Myers said supply remains constrained with memory the main bottleneck, followed by NAND, CPUs and drives, and that HPE has signed longer-term supply agreements to improve component access.
key_facts.excerpt: CFO Marie Myers noted that supply remained constrained, with memory being the main bottleneck, followed by NAND, CPUs and drives, though HPE has signed longer-term supply agreements to improve access to components.

key_facts.fact: HPE's inventory ballooned to $11.82 billion at the end of July from $7.16 billion a year earlier, which Myers attributed to higher commodity costs and targeted purchases to support rising orders and backlog.
key_facts.excerpt: HPE's inventory of $11.82 billion at the end of July was up from $7.16 billion last year. The increase reflects "higher commodity costs and targeted purchases to support increased orders and increased backlog," Myers said.

stories.headline: Equinix and Nvidia launch Inference Exchange, renting AI inference across 280 data centers

key_facts.fact: Equinix announced on September 2 a significant expansion of its collaboration with Nvidia to deliver Equinix Inference Exchange, a distributed AI inference program for global enterprises, alongside a new collaboration with Together AI.
key_facts.excerpt: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Equinix, Inc.(Nasdaq: EQIX)... today announced a significant expansion of its longtime collaboration with NVIDIA to deliver Equinix Inference Exchange, a distributed AI inference program for global enterprises, alongside a new collaboration with Together AI.

key_facts.fact: The program combines Nvidia's validated Enterprise Reference Architectures with Together AI's inference platform, which supports more than 200 open-source models, delivered through Equinix's data centers and Equinix Fabric.
key_facts.excerpt: This collaboration brings together NVIDIA's validated Enterprise Reference Architectures with Together AI's inference platform, supporting more than 200 open-source models.

key_facts.fact: Equinix operates more than 280 data centers across 77 metros with 230 cloud on-ramps and over 10,500 interconnected businesses, and says eight of the top 10 AI model providers and nine of the top 10 AI clouds are deployed with it.
key_facts.excerpt: Equinix brings unmatched scale and ecosystem density to this challenge, with more than 280 data centers across 77 metros, 230 cloud on-ramps and over 10,500 businesses interconnected on its neutral exchange.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang spoke by video with Equinix CEO Adaire Fox-Martin at the company's Horizon event in San Francisco, saying Equinix's locations let customers be 'close to where the action is, where all the sensors are.'
key_facts.excerpt: Huang said that the location of Equinix's facilities allow you to be "close to where the action is, where all the sensors are." And because the architecture is distributed, "you could both simultaneously be close and be far away," he said.

key_facts.fact: Financial terms were not disclosed; Together AI will be the seller of record billing end customers, and Inference Exchange will be available starting in the first quarter of 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Financing details for Wednesday's deal weren't disclosed. Zand said Together AI, which offers access to 200 open-source models, will be the seller of record... Called Equinix Inference Exchange, it will be available in the first quarter of 2027.

key_facts.fact: Equinix shares are up 33% in 2026, lifting its market capitalization to $100 billion; its data centers are optimized for Nvidia's B300 Blackwell Ultra GPUs, with some liquid-cooled sites able to run the newer Vera Rubin chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Equinix shares are up 33% this year, lifting the company's market cap to $100 billion... Equinix data centers are optimized for Nvidia's B300 Blackwell Ultra GPUs, but it also has some liquid-cooled facilities where customers can use the newer Vera Rubin chips.

stories.headline: China's Zeroth launches Bridge, an 88cm humanoid with an open-source robot skill ecosystem

key_facts.fact: Suzhou-based Zeroth launched Bridge, which it calls the world's first AI-native embodied robot, alongside OpenBridge, a fully open-source ecosystem for embodied intelligence; global booking opened September 2, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Zeroth today launched Bridge, the world's first AI-native embodied robot, alongside OpenBridge, a fully open-source ecosystem for embodied intelligence... The Zeroth Bridge is available for global booking starting September 2, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Bridge stands 88 cm tall, weighs about 13 kg, and has 30-40 cm arms with two-finger grippers, shipping with bipedal walking, obstacle avoidance and a library of human-like movements.
key_facts.excerpt: Standing 88 cm tall and weighing approximately 13 kg, Bridge features a compact humanoid form with 30-40 cm arms and two-finger grippers... Bridge ships with a broad set of capabilities out of the box, including stable bipedal walking, intelligent obstacle avoidance, and a full library of natural, human-like movements and choreography.

key_facts.fact: Developers get full access to underlying SDKs, open motion-control APIs and motion capture/VR integration; OpenBridge adds shared training resources and a public Skill Hub so capabilities can be shared across the community.
key_facts.excerpt: Tech enthusiasts and developers will gain full access to underlying SDKs, open motion-control APIs, and motion capture & VR integration... Supported by unified development tools, shared training resources and a public Skill Hub, OpenBridge creates an open development environment.

key_facts.fact: Zeroth also opened a Bridge Builder Program whose first phase shortlists 500 developers, with the top 200 getting free access to Bridge and the remaining 300 receiving priority purchase access to the Bridge Geek Edition.
key_facts.excerpt: In its first phase, 500 developers will be shortlisted for a co-creation challenge, with the Top 200 receiving complimentary access to experience Bridge... The remaining 300 shortlisted developers will receive priority purchase access to the Bridge Geek Edition.

key_facts.fact: Founder and CEO Renjie Guo framed the launch as an Android-style opening of robotics: 'The world has no shortage of walls. We choose to build bridges.'
key_facts.excerpt: "We hope that one day, everyone can participate in creating robots. To make that possible, we want to make robotics more open to everyone," said Renjie Guo, Founder and CEO of Zeroth.

key_facts.fact: Zeroth was founded in 2024 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China, building full-stack robot systems around proprietary components, motion control and embodied AI foundation models.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, the company leverages proprietary core components, motion control systems, and embodied AI foundation models to build full-stack intelligent robot systems for real-world applications.

stories.headline: LG Electronics and NC AI win Korean state project for humanoids running domestic on-device AI chips

key_facts.fact: NC AI said on September 3 that it was selected, in a consortium with LG Electronics, to carry out the humanoid segment of the K-On-Device AI Semiconductor Technology Development Project run by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and the Korea Evaluation Institute of Industrial Technology.
key_facts.excerpt: NC AI said on the 3rd that it has been selected, as part of a consortium with LG Electronics, to carry out the humanoid segment of the K-On-Device AI Semiconductor Technology Development Project, run by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and the Korea Evaluation Institute of Industrial Technology (KEIT).

key_facts.fact: The project centers on autonomous humanoid robots equipped with domestically made on-device AI chips able to perform human-level tasks in complex everyday spaces.
key_facts.excerpt: The project centers on developing autonomous humanoid robots equipped with domestically made on-device AI chips that can perform human-level tasks in complex everyday spaces.

key_facts.fact: NC AI will take sole charge of building General Motion Tracking (GMT) data and a human-to-robot retargeting pipeline that accounts for joint limits, body proportions, foot support and balance conditions, and will build a digital twin environment to generate training motion datasets.
key_facts.excerpt: NC AI will take sole charge of building initial learning-based General Motion Tracking (GMT) data and a human-to-robot retargeting pipeline that transfers human movements to robots... To that end, the company will build a digital twin environment to secure large volumes of training motion datasets.

key_facts.fact: The stated goal is to secure high-performance, low-power on-device AI chips and core robotics technologies for real-time motion control ahead of rivals, integrating hardware, data, AI models and domestic chips into a single development framework.
key_facts.excerpt: The ultimate goal is to secure, ahead of rivals, the high-performance, low-power on-device AI chips and core robotics technologies essential for real-time motion control in unstructured everyday spaces.

key_facts.fact: Targets include general-purpose home humanoids that organize, carry, serve and handle tools, plus industrial and public uses such as manufacturing and logistics support, disaster response, facility inspection and hazardous-area work.
key_facts.excerpt: The technology will be applied broadly to general-purpose humanoids that help with organizing, carrying, serving and handling tools in the home, as well as to industrial and public sectors requiring advanced autonomous control.

stories.headline: Anker's Eufy MindBase puts a dedicated AI chip and an on-device LLM inside the smart home

key_facts.fact: Anker announced the Eufy MindBase at IFA in Berlin, a local AI hub for its security cameras running an on-device, Anker-developed LLM that the company says processes footage without it leaving the home.
key_facts.excerpt: Anker is launching the Eufy MindBase, a local AI hub for its security cameras that runs an on-device, Anker-developed LLM, which the company says can process your footage without it ever leaving your home.

key_facts.fact: The MindBase has a dedicated AI chip and up to 48TB of expandable storage, enabling natural-language search across recordings, event summaries and face/person/car/pet/stranger detection with no monthly fee.
key_facts.excerpt: With up to 48TB of expandable storage and a dedicated AI chip, the MindBase can process events directly for advanced AI features, including natural-language search across recordings and event summaries, without a monthly fee.

key_facts.fact: Anker is pitching it as the 'central brain for the home' rather than a camera accessory, with plans to add an energy agent for home power and a 'clean agent' for robot vacuums; price and release date were not revealed.
key_facts.excerpt: Pitched as the "central brain for the home," the MindBase is not just for Eufy security cameras... the company plans to add an energy agent for your home's power, a clean agent for your robot vacuums, and more. Anker hasn't revealed the price or release date yet.

key_facts.fact: The hub runs Matter 1.5 as a controller supporting over 40 Matter device categories, has dual-band Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Thread and Zigbee, works with Apple HomeKit Secure Video, and supports 16 wireless cameras, four wired cameras and 34 sensors.
key_facts.excerpt: Anker says the MindBase will be a Matter controller, running Matter 1.5, and will support over 40 Matter device categories... It will support 16 wireless cameras and four wired cameras, along with 34 sensors.

key_facts.fact: Anker also announced a TrackLight Cam S1, an S4 video doorbell and a window camera at the show; Eufy previously drew criticism for claiming its cameras were end-to-end encrypted when they were not always.
key_facts.excerpt: It's also announcing a handful of other smart home security products at the IFA tech show in Berlin this week, including the TrackLight Cam S1, the S4 video doorbell, and a window camera... Eufy got into trouble a few years back for claiming its cameras were end-to-end encrypted when they weren't always.
